target_customer: Developers and companies building voice agents that need speech to text, LLM and text to speech models; the company site also pitches teams running AI phone agents for calls such as screening, intake and scheduling
problem: Choosing the best speech model per language and use case is a manual bake-off, and models change weekly. Speko measures models publicly and routes each call to the best one.
business_model: Usage-based API router with public benchmarks, plus a no-code console for phone agents
product_category: Voice AI model router and voice agent platform

founders.name: Beknazar Abdikamalov
previous_startups: Hupo (voice AI company, per YC page raised $14M, backed by DST Global and Meta)
founders.background_notes: YC page says he shipped production voice AI for Fortune 500 clients in 10+ languages over four years at Hupo.

competitors.name: LiveKit Inference
competitors.what: Low latency model gateway for voice AI from LiveKit

competitors.name: Telnyx STT router
competitors.what: Single API routing across multiple speech to text providers

competitors.name: SLNG voice AI gateway
competitors.what: One interface for STT, TTS and LLM calls routed by language, cost, quality or region

technical_complexity.rationale: A router is standard API engineering, and the hard part is running continuous multi-language benchmarks of new models with credible results.

defensibility.rationale: Benchmarks are public so they can be copied, and several gateways already exist, so any moat rests on measurement data and speed of testing new models.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: As of the record date, LiveKit, Telnyx, SLNG and Inworld all offered routing or gateways; no acquisition or copy of Speko specifically is reported.

market_need_then: Voice agent builders face fast model churn and language specific quality gaps, and the founder says he ran the bake-off by hand for four years at his prior company.

branding.domain_note: Uses speko.ai; no purchase history found

identity.logo: Not described by any source opened
identity.visual_style: Plain product site with benchmark pages
identity.voice_and_tone: Short, direct, practical copy with concrete examples such as free credit on signup, no sales call

branding.brand_signature: OpenRouter for Voice tagline plus public benchmarks site
branding.community_and_virality: Launch HN post titled Launch HN: Speko (YC S26) OpenRouter for Voice AI and several aggregator write-ups

brand_strength.rationale: The borrowed OpenRouter framing explains the product quickly, but only launch coverage exists and no source covers the brand itself.

outcome_analysis: Speko is a Summer 2026 company that launched publicly in August 2026 with a repeat founder from a voice AI startup, so no outcome exists yet. The wedge is credible benchmark driven routing, but several gateways from larger voice vendors already compete, and the site has widened toward a phone agent platform.
notes: Unverified funding figures: one outlet preview (runtimewire, partly paywalled) says $1.1M raised plus a $500K YC commitment, about $1.6M. Dealroom shows a $125K seed and CB Insights shows $500K convertible note. These conflict and all come from aggregators or one outlet, so no round is recorded. The company site describes a voice agent platform for business calls while the YC page describes a model router. Outcome search found no news on the company.
